messages:
sarah.sales: Heads up — Armstrong Inc. (contract ACME‑ARM-2025) says their PO note that should have applied the enterprise promo didn’t land. Sales approved a manual credit for the add-on seats ($12,500). Can billing do a manual ledger adjustment and confirm audit trail? Need it posted before month-end. PO#: PO-987654, invoice: INV-2025-1043.

josh.cs: adding context — customer says promo code ENTERPRISE25 was on the PO note but we never reflected it on the invoice. They escalated to their procurement team. Do you have logs or a repro for why parser missed the note?

maria.billing: looking. quick check in billing parser logs — I see a parse error at ingestion for PO-987654: missing newline normalization caused the "promo:ENTERPRISE25" token to be concatenated with another field. raw snippet: 
```
2025-06-29 14:02:11 INFO ingest: received PO-987654 payload
2025-06-29 14:02:11 WARN parse: fieldPromo could not extract token \"promo:ENTERPRIS E25\" (offset mismatch)
2025-06-29 14:02:11 ERROR ledger: skipping promo apply step
```
Looks like a whitespace/encoding glitch from the customer's ERP export. That explains why invoice INV-2025-1043 charged full price.

maria.billing: Proposed remediation: create manual negative ledger entry for INV-2025-1043, amount 12,500 USD, reference PO-987654 and contract ACME-ARM-2025, attach audit note and original PO PDF. I can do this if approvals are confirmed. API call I will use (internal):
```bash
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $LEDGER_KEY\" 
  https://internal.redwood/ledger/adjust 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2025-1043","amount":-12500,"currency":"USD","reason":"Sales manual credit per PO-987654 — ENTERPRISE25 promo not applied","metadata":{"po":"PO-987654","contract":"ACME-ARM-2025","approved_by":"sarah.sales"}}'
```

kevin.support: tagging finance /ops: we need finance sign-off record. @sarah.sales can you confirm approvals (email thread or slack confirmation)? Also ensure customer-facing note is drafted for billing statement.

sarah.sales: confirmed — Sales email thread from 2025-06-28 shows VP approval. attaching link to thread: https://redwood.mail/threads/abcd1234 (internal). Approved by Megan V. No further approvals needed from Sales side.

josh.cs: quick question for the audit — will the ledger entry include the original PO as attachment? We should include that to avoid follow-ups.

maria.billing: yes will include PO PDF and note. Creating adjustment now.

ledger-bot: audit: creating adjustment request id ADJ-2025-7781, queued for processing.

maria.billing: adjustment processed. transaction id TXN-ADJ-2025-7781, amount -12500 USD, balance updated. Posted to invoice INV-2025-1043. Attached artifacts: /files/PO-987654.pdf, /files/approval-meganV-2025-06-28.pdf.

ledger-bot: system: ledger entry ADJ-2025-7781 created by maria.billing (request id 5f7b...). Audit log at https://internal.redwood/ledger/audit/ADJ-2025-7781

kevin.support: thanks — can you drop a short billing note to the customer summarizing the fix? I can help with language.

sarah.sales: I'll send a one-paragraph note and copy billing. Draft: "Hi Allen, we've applied an enterprise promo credit of $12,500 to invoice INV-2025-1043 after confirming the PO note (PO-987654). The credit is reflected on your next statement. Apologies for the confusion; let us know if you need a revised invoice." OK to send?

maria.billing: fine with me. I confirmed the audit link and attachments.

josh.cs: closing loop — root cause ticket: BILLING-1354 (PO ingestion whitespace bug). ETA for parser fix? Maria?

maria.billing: I have a small patch queued; should be out in next prod deploy (2025-07-02). Will add e2e test for trimming odd whitespace in promo tokens.

kevin.support: marking thread resolved for the customer escalation. If anything else pops up, reopen. :white_check_mark:

sarah.sales: thanks team — great cross-functional move. :tada:
